name: pop
description: Catchy, polished, radio-friendly songs with big hooks, bright production and sing-along choruses. Mainstream chart hits that fit almost any setting.

name: lofi
description: Mellow instrumental beats with soft drums, vinyl crackle and warm keys. Low-key background music for studying, reading, coding and late nights.

name: rock
description: Loud electric guitars, driving drums and powerful vocals. Raw, high-energy band music with attitude.

name: ambient
description: Slow, spacious, atmospheric soundscapes with almost no beat or vocals. Floating textures for sleep, meditation, deep calm and quiet thinking.

name: jazz
description: Warm acoustic instruments such as piano, saxophone, upright bass and brushed drums, with swing and improvisation. Smooth, sophisticated music for cafes, dinners and evenings.

name: synthwave
description: Retro 1980s-inspired electronic music with glowing synthesizers, pulsing bass and a neon night-drive atmosphere.

name: indie pop
description: Bright, quirky, melodic pop from independent artists with jangly guitars and a lighter, less polished feel than mainstream pop.

name: hip hop
description: Rhythmic spoken verses and rhymes over heavy beats and bass. Lyrical flow, swagger and street storytelling.

name: classical
description: Orchestral and piano compositions with strings, symphonies and sonatas. Elegant, timeless instrumental music for concentration and quiet reflection.

name: metal
description: Extremely heavy distorted guitars, pounding double-bass drums and fierce vocals. Dark, fast, aggressive and loud.

name: country
description: Storytelling songs with acoustic guitar, fiddle and twang about home, small towns, open roads and heartache.

name: r&b
description: Smooth soulful vocals over slow grooves and silky production. Sensual, romantic music about love and relationships.

name: edm
description: Electronic dance music with pounding four-on-the-floor beats, big drops and festival energy for clubs, raves and parties.

name: folk
description: Gentle acoustic songs with fingerpicked guitar, soft vocals and traditional storytelling. Intimate, earthy and often wistful.

name: reggae
description: Laid-back offbeat rhythms, deep bass and sunny island grooves from Jamaica. Easygoing beach and summer music.

name: blues
description: Slow soulful guitar, harmonica and aching vocals about hardship, loss and heartbreak. Gritty and emotional.

name: k-pop
description: Korean pop music with glossy production, choreographed dance tracks and catchy group hooks.

name: punk
description: Fast, short, loud, rebellious guitar songs with shouted vocals and raw energy.

name: house
description: Steady four-on-the-floor club beats with hypnotic synth loops built for long dancing sessions.

name: soul
description: Passionate gospel-rooted vocals with warm horns and deep feeling.

name: latin
description: Spanish-language dance rhythms with percussion, brass and tropical heat.

name: disco
description: Funky 1970s dance-floor grooves with strings, four-on-the-floor drums and glittering energy.
